title: Kevin Lynch publishes The Image of the City
description: Names paths, edges, districts, nodes and landmarks as the elements of a legible place; later a staple of park wayfinding.

title: Masahiro Mori describes the uncanny valley
description: Essay in the Japanese journal Energy sketches the dip in affinity for almost-human figures.

title: John Fruin publishes Pedestrian Planning and Design
description: Introduces pedestrian level of service grades based on space per person.

title: Euro Disney opens near Paris
description: Opens with largely American menus and no alcohol in the park; attendance misses forecasts.

title: Euro Disney begins serving wine and beer with meals
description: Reverses the no-alcohol policy in response to European expectations.

title: Hong Kong Disneyland opens
description: Designed with feng shui advice, including a bend in the entrance walkway.

title: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design issued
description: US standards include sections 234 and 1002 on amusement rides: wheelchair spaces, transfer seats and devices.

title: Sesame Place becomes the first theme park Certified Autism Center
description: IBCCES certification with staff training, a sensory guide and quiet rooms.
